Generated by tools/build_cases.py. Prose: These are the IS and IZ queue-based setups. Directly after this point, which is see TIO, TTIO ***suffers the worst difficulty spike seen in PC anywhere*** in my opinion. There are no always-buildable 100% T/O 3ps for all \[TIO\]\! queues (although, one does exist for one where you can access T in the next bag of \[TIO\]\!) and there is only ***one*** usable 3-piece for 100% T/I saving. / This will be the *first and only time* I will permit using OQB to simplify saves. This is because I genuinely believe it to be better.
